Title: Reform body and the soul gem

Messages.Author: ne...@doughty-engineering.co.uk
Messages.Body:
Just a quick question,
If for instance Dragos got a soul gem and then vissitude
poisoning...then played enough cards to burn him self would he trigger
the soul gem if he burned and then played a reform body.

If not then can you describe what happens exactly.

Many thanks,
Ste...@doughty-engineering.co.uk

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
ne...@doughty-engineering.co.uk wrote:
> If for instance Dragos got a soul gem and then vissitude
> poisoning...then played enough cards to burn him self would he trigger
> the soul gem if he burned and then played a reform body.

No.
Soul Gem kicks in when the bearer is burned. Reform Body replaces
the burn effect with a go to torpor effect.
If you wait for the Soul Gem effect to kick in before playing
Reform Body, Dragos will be safely in the ash heap by the time
the Soul Gem effect is finished, and cannot play Reform Body.

In this case, it wouldn't be that interesting anyhow:

Dragos could choose to reform body first, but would then be
burned again by Vicissitude Poisoning, at which time the Soul
Gem would kick in after all.
